summary: Frontend-only iteration 4 testing complete. ReplayScrubber, distinct Settings page, and 3-step Onboarding all functional end-to-end. 24/26 assertions passed; 2 minor anomalies noted below.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking scrub-marker-7 (CW-2041, 16-step script) lands on streamIndex=7 instead of expected 8. Likely race with the parent track's onMouseDown handler (which fires first via bubbling and sets index from clientX rounding); marker's onClick uses stopPropagation but mousedown is not stopped. For interior markers the rounded ratio sometimes lands on i instead of i+1 due to Math.round half-to-even/translate-x positioning. Other markers (0, 10) work correctly. Suggest adding e.stopPropagation() to onMouseDown on marker as well, or change track to react to click instead of mousedown.

integration_issues.issue: Substring match for the literal 'Step 1 of 3' lede did not assert positively in one body-text scrape, although StepDot indicators (1/2/3) and check-mark transitions visibly work and step 2→3 nav succeeded. Likely innerText whitespace artifact rather than a real missing element. No user-visible bug.

action_items: ReplayScrubber: stop mousedown propagation on marker (or change track listener to onClick) so marker clicks land on exactly streamIndex=i+1, matching the visual marker. Currently interior markers can be off-by-one.
critical_code_review_comments: ReplayScrubber.jsx · marker onClick stops only click propagation; the track listens on mousedown which bubbles and races with the click handler. This is the root cause of the off-by-one observed on interior markers.

Only minor finding: marker-click off-by-one on interior markers (see action_items).
rca of the issue: ReplayScrubber: track div has onMouseDown={onTrackDown} which calls onSeek(clientX). Markers are children of the track. When you click a marker, mousedown bubbles to the track first (markers don't stopPropagation on mousedown — only on click). onSeek does Math.round((clientX-rect.left)/rect.width * total) — for marker positioned at ((i+0.5)/total)*100% the rounded value can land on i (banker's-rounding-style) instead of i+1, depending on sub-pixel translate-x rendering. Then click fires and would set i+1 — but if React commits both, depending on timing the mousedown value may persist. Fix: add onMouseDown={(e)=>e.stopPropagation()} to the marker wrapper, or move the track seek to onClick.
